final_message:
Blog post URLs now keep the base letter of accented characters, so "Crème brûlée recipes" becomes `creme-brulee-recipes`. `npm test` passes all 3 tests, including `test/blog-slug.test.js`.

The fix is in `src/blog/slug.js`. `postSlug` now strips accents from the title before passing it to `slugify`. I didn't change `vendor/slugify/index.js`, because its header says it's vendored and shouldn't be edited by hand. Shop product URLs also use `slugify`, so they still drop accented letters. If you want the same fix there, it needs the same change in `src/shop/product-url.js`, or a shared helper.
